{{Top|leg}}
An '''emergency repair kit''' was stored aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Sold at the same time as the ship, they generally contained tools and materials to patch two minor hull breaches. Emergency repair kits contained [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanners]], a [[sonic screwdriver]], [[foam-jet]], and ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramic]] patch material. Emergency repair kits were upgraded automatically during supply restocks at larger [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].
